source_text.body:
Have an AI control the PC to file taxes
A commenter says they had AI control their PC and submit their taxes for them, in a thread about simple personal taxes with rental income.
·
Nov 6, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
In the Reddit thread, the commenter says they had Claude control their PC and submit the return, after filing an extension and turning in taxes the prior month. In a reply describing a similar setup, another commenter says they watched the AI fill out TurboTax screen by screen through a browser plugin on a widescreen display, while they audited the numbers themselves and cross-checked with other models or manual review.
How it went
The source only claims it worked "insanely" well and that the user found a few items needing attention during review; it gives no refund, accuracy, or time-saved numbers for this specific PC-control run.
Worth knowing
The main catch from the thread is that the user still manually cross-validated the methods and numbers, rather than trusting the agent unattended.
Try it yourself
with
Claude computer use
Copy prompt
Help me prepare my [year] [country] tax return using the documents in [folder path], including [income types, e.g. wages and rental income]. Fill in the forms in [tax software or website] step by step, and tell me which figures came from which document. Pause before entering any login details and before submitting or paying anything, so I can review every number first. You're done when the return is fully filled in and I've got a list of anything you were unsure about.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/OpenAI/comments/1xozral/ai_for_tax_prep
